# How to get your agent skill found by AI agents: list it on varg how to

**A skill folder or repo becomes a checked catalog card, shown to you first, then sent for review on varg how to.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_84e7e9d2bbbe.webp" alt="The varg how to publish page (&quot;Your agent publishes it&quot;) hands over to a finished listing: the Video Moodboard card with its preview, install buttons and summary." width="480"></p>

Turn your agent skill into a varg how to listing: reads a skill folder or repo, checks it against the varg media skill standard, fills the one card format every listing on varg how to (varg.ai/how-to) uses — name, one-line summary, use-when triggers, category, install command, a real example of the output — shows it to the person and publishes it for review through the varg MCP publish_skill tool (or the API with a varg key). Use when someone says "publish my skill", "list this skill on varg", "submit my skill to varg how to", "add my skill to the catalog", "how do I get my skill found by agents", or the same in any language. Not for finding a skill (use how-to-make-ai-video), not for writing the skill itself, and not for contributing to the vargHQ/skills repo (that is a pull request).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-publish-skill                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-publish-skill --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 82 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | A catalog listing sent for review |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | free |
| Uses | varg MCP, varg API |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.0.0) |

## Ask your agent

- "Publish the skill in ./caption-maker to varg how to"
- "Check my repo github.com/me/thumbnail-maker against the varg standard and submit it to the catalog"
- "How do I get the video tool I built found by agents? Fill the listing card and show it to me first"
